label: rpe-psi-e-vs-xi-klqr-three-targets-2026-11-27
description: Echo-only KLQR with eigenfunctions of the echo alone, psi(e) evaluated directly, against eigenfunctions of the first two causal echo-history coordinates, psi(xi1, xi2), on the mild, strong and hard radius targets. Each formulation trains and controls with the pipeline as is (psi-e/jobs, psi-xi/jobs); the figures follow each run: radius and echo in time and frequency (the echo and its target lifted offline through (r, r') by control_target), and the controller's eigenfunction (mode 0) along the run and its target. psi(e) on the hard target diverges within 0.005 tau, too short for a spectrum.
